source.notes: ICSE Class VII school final term examination paper, English Language (school not named). Header prints 'Final Term Examination 2017-2018', 'Std. : VII', 'Subject : English Language', 'Full Marks : 80', 'Time : 2hrs.+15mins.'; examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name); durationMinutes 135 = 2 h + 15 min as printed. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Q1 (composition, any one of four, [20]) and Q2 (letter, any one of two, [10]) are one entry per option with a shared choiceGroup. Q3 is a comprehension on a long Sindbad passage (with an illustration) that is not reproduced; Q3 is printed as [10] while its sub-parts carry [2] each for (i) a)-e) (the (i) heading prints [20]), [3] for (ii), [4] for (iii) and [3] for (iv), i.e. 20 in total; the per-item printed marks are used, which makes the paper add up to the printed 80. Q4 [5], Q5 [5] and Q6 [10] print marks only for the whole group, so each is one entry. Q7 a)-d) are separate entries with their printed marks. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.

questions.text: Write a composition on any one of the following topics. A school Picnic.

Write a composition on any one of the following topics. You were waiting for your mother at a railway station. Write a description of the place in detail and also write about your feelings and observation.
Write a composition on any one of the following topics. Imagine that you were near a swimming pool where someone was almost drowned. Write in detail what happened there.
Write a composition on any one of the following topics. Write an original short story beginning with the line, 'It was a cold winter night'......................."
Write a letter on any one of the following : Write a letter to your friend inviting him to your Birthday Party.

Write a letter on any one of the following : Write a letter to the Superintendent of Police to show your concern about the overcrowded school vehicles and request him to take strict action against it.

questions.text:
Fill in the blanks with appropriate prepositions : (write only answers).
a) She has been learning music ____ March.
b) The police rushed ____ the building.
c) You can stay here ____ two days.
d) The joggers walked ____ the river.
e) You have to go ____ the hill.
f) A dispute arose ____ the landlord and the tenant.
g) The cat sprang ____ the table.
h) Our teacher told us ____ Abraham Lincoln.
i) She is far superior ____ her husband in intelligence.
j) They congratulated us ____ our success in the tournament.
extractionIssues: Marks printed only for the whole group ([5] for ten items)

questions.text:
Fill in the blanks with the correct form of the verb given in the bracket :
a) I ____ (return) all the books to library that I ____ (borrow) last week.
b) This hotel ____ (serve) only vegetation food.
c) Raja Ram Mohan Roy____ (be) a social reformer, who ____ (live) in the nineteenth century.
d) My parents ____ (leave) for Singapore tomorrow.
e) He ____ (visit) his family every weekend.
f) The gardener ____ (cut) grass whole of yesterday afternoon.
g) I ____ (spend) a lot of money on books last year.
h) She ____ (learn) French because she wants to go to France.
extractionIssues: Marks printed only for the whole group ([5] for eight items)

questions.text:
Do as directed.
a) The boys laughed at the beggar. (Begin the sentence with : The beggar..............)
b) Delhi is the largest town in India. (Rewrite using 'large')
c) Ratan cannot afford a car. He is very poor. (Join the sentences using infinitive).
d) Mr. Kapoor is very friendly. He lives in our colony. (Join the sentences using relative pronoun).
e) We need your vote. We want your support. (Join using not only..................but also).
f) As soon as he saw the tiger, he ran away. (Begin the sentence with : No sooner................)
g) No other play in Sanskrit is as good as Shakuntala. (Rewrite the sentence using 'better').
h) The students finished their work and entered the classroom. (Begin the sentence with : Having.......)
i) We used to light a fire in winter. (Place adverb always in the right position)
j) This news is too good to be true. (Rewrite using : So.................that)
extractionIssues: Marks printed only for the whole group ([10] for ten items)
